votes.motion: Motion to approve the development plan review for the used car lot at 10 Massachusetts Avenue with the outlined conditions (parking striping, one handicap space, no loading or delivery 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, delivery not blocking access to the rear).
votes.quote: m. allison, motion to approve with outlined conditions: parking is striped in accordance with the fourteen (14) spaces shown on the plan.

votes.motion: Amended motion that a 15 foot wide loading zone is provided behind the building.
votes.quote: m. allison amended motion that a 15 foot wide loading zone is provided behind the building, second, k. chenis, all aye.
